dedupe_keys.name: shake table test of a two story mass timber building with post tensioned rocking walls

description: Shake Table Test of A Two-story Mass Timber Building with Post-tensioned Rocking Walls is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Shiling Pei, Colorado School of Mines (mines.edu). This testing program is a full scale sake table test of a two-story mass timber building at NHERI@UCSD facility. The building is a wood building built with glulam beams and columns with Cross Laminated Panel (CLT) floors. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-k3y4-y384. Keywords: shake table test, mass timber building, post-tensioned rocking wall, cross laminated timber (CLT), natural hazard, earthquake. Published 2019-05-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
